note: Deterministic descriptive embeddings: category/axis metadata plus Core Text glyph metrics and normalized raster shape measurements. L2-normalized, weighted feature groups. Specimen Vision embeddings use identical copy, placement and image preprocessing across fonts. These are font similarity descriptors, not a trained historical-style classifier or automatic font identification. Fonts remain OFL assets, registered only in the app process.
specimenRecipe: three fixed-copy rows; independent text position per row; sRGB PNG scaleFit Vision rev2
